title: Multi-Signing
key_points: Multi-signing allows a set of signers to authorize transactions on an account.
Signers are specified in the account's settings, and can be changed at any time.
Each transaction requires a subset of signers to approve it before being executed.
The number of required signers for each transaction can be configured per-account.
Multi-signing is similar to hierarchical deterministic (HD) wallets but with less complexity.
limitations: Scope is limited to the XRP Ledger and its use cases may vary depending on the application.
asserts: Multi-signing enables multiple signers to jointly control an account in the XRP Ledger.
scope: The context of this source is within the XRP Ledger's account management features, specifically multi-signing functionality.
